reason: ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month, forever, for something my register and WhatsApp already do for free. I don't pay monthly for anything I can avoid, and on a Sunday rush my girls will not stop to take selfies and type numbers into an app.
objection: The monthly fee never ends, and my staff are busy with customers; they won't type everything in, so I'd be paying for an app nobody uses properly.
would_change_my_mind: No setup charge and a one-time or yearly price around ₹3,000, plus seeing another salon nearby actually catching cash leaks with the drawer check.
